blocking_constraints.constraint: Publishing a twelfth model will likely break the build again. public/ is 549 MB of binary geometry shipped through the app bundle. TWO different ceilings were hit on 2026-09-15 by actual failure, not prediction: the serverless function traced to 296.3 MB against Vercel's 250 MB limit, and later pnpm run build OOM'd twice on the 4-core/8 GB builder. Enhanced Builds (8 cores/16 GB) cleared the second; neither fix removed the cause.

Do not trust a green suite as evidence that an artifact is correct. Every significant defect this session passed tsc, ESLint and thousands of unit tests: an inferred MEP network drawn floating above the house; an HVAC layer containing 5% of its geometry behind a healthy-looking 2.5 MB file; a grade sentence claiming a certification the product never performs; a next.config comment describing a protection an include cannot provide; and a published floor area of 110 m² for a nineteen-storey, 105-apartment block, which was 110 one-square-metre plot-number stamps. Open the page, read the label beside the number, and check what a quantity actually measures.
blocking_constraints.discovered_by: Five confirmed defects, each found by inspection after tests were already green.

blocking_constraints.constraint: Service layers have NO draw-call budget while the detail (200) and material (300) layers do. That is why Sixty5's plumbing.glb shipped needing 2,462 draw calls — West Riverside's worst layer needs 737 — with no build-time complaint.
